## Summary
The last **construction** blocker before GATE G1. P0.15h proved the entire live Review pipeline through delivery mechanics, but the delivery transaction hard-fails `cited_not_fetched`: the fact-check agent does **no real, logged web fetches** (`usage_records.searches = 0`), so its claim-ledger citations are model-knowledge, not fetch-backed, and §12.8(c) correctly refuses to deliver.

Root cause (diagnosed live, P0.15h): the vendored `claude` CLI does **not** reliably add Anthropic's server-side `web_search` tool to the `/v1/messages` request. This PR makes the agent's web research **real and proxy-logged** by making the egress-proxy — the run's single meter of record and only network path — the **guarantor** of the tool (the ticket's "most robust" approach #3), so `cited⇒fetched` gets real provenance and a COMPLETE green Review can deliver.

**Stage A (offline construction) only.** Stage B (a metered live `dev` run) is **[OPERATOR GATE]d** and unchanged by this PR — see AC3/AC4.

Implements `docs/tickets/16_P0.15i__agent-web-research-in-sandbox.md`. Stacked on P0.15h (#24).

## What changed
- **`apps/egress-proxy/src/url-policy.ts`** — new `ensureServerWebTools`: ADD-IF-ABSENT the server `web_search` tool to every `POST /v1/messages` body that lacks one, then the existing `injectUrlPolicyIntoBody` scopes its domains. A CLI-added tool is scoped, never duplicated; the input body is never mutated. Basic `web_search_20250305` variant — the only one valid across the *whole* Rhema model line (incl. the `claude-haiku-4-5` research subagent, which can't use the newer `_20260209` variant).
- **`apps/egress-proxy/src/handler.ts`** — wired into the shared `prepareProxyRequest` (buffered **and** SSE), gated to `POST /v1/messages` (excludes `count_tokens`). The `ensured.added` term forwards the tool even when the run has no URL policy (the common case).
- **`apps/egress-proxy/src/context.ts`** — `RunContext.webTools` (`WebToolPolicy`) for per-run tuning. `web_fetch` defaults **OFF**: its basic variant is gated behind the `web-fetch-2025-09-10` beta header the proxy doesn't yet set, so injecting it would 400 the whole request; `web_search` alone gives `cited⇒fetched` its provenance. Doc mandates §12.6 input-scoped subagents be minted with web tools disabled (owned by the deferred scoped-query wiring, D-P0.15h-5).
- **`packages/engine/src/options.ts` + `roster.ts`** — drop the sandbox-unroutable client `WebFetch` from `ALLOWED_TOOLS` + the `researcher` roster (AC1). `WebSearch` (the allow-signal) stays; the hook/mapper name normalization is untouched; the holdout-calibrator's separate §12.6 fetcher grant is intentionally left.

## Design decisions
- **Proxy as guarantor (not the SDK):** the CLI assembles `tools[]` inside a compiled binary not in-tree, and the implicit path was proven not to work live. The proxy already owns the web-tool body, is the single meter of record, and can see the request `model` — the only place a deterministic, testable fix belongs.
- **web_fetch off by default:** avoids a beta-header 400 trap on every request; not needed for G1. Plumbing kept dormant for a follow-up that wires the header.
- Metering (`web_search_requests`→`usage_records.searches`) and result-URL logging (`collectResultUrls`, landed in P0.15h `f242ab8`) already close the chain — **verified end-to-end, not rebuilt**.
